exposure: immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (IUCD) insertion
cohort: 120 women who underwent either vaginal or c-section delivery.
finding: Immediate postpartum IUCD insertion was found to be effective and safe with a low complication rate after both vaginal and cesarean section deliveries.
mod_finding: The IUCD removal rate was higher in the c-section group compared to the vaginal delivery group (11.67% vs. 3.33%).
